notes.title: VERSION 1.1 – Clarity, Control & Better UX
notes.notes:
[h1]🔧 Version 1.1 – Clarity, Control & Better UX[/h1]
Thank you for all the feedback and support! This update focuses on improving clarity, giving players more control, and polishing core systems and interactions.
[h2]🌟 Highlights[/h2][list]  [*][b]Lighting improvements[/b] on multiple maps – we heard your feedback about dark areas, and they should now be much easier to read.[/*]  [*][b]Evolutions can now be skipped[/b] – if the offered upgrades don’t fit your strategy, just pass them![/*]  [*][b]New tutorial[/b] added for the Camp event.[/*]  [*]A reminder tutorial now appears if you haven’t merged towers for a while.[/*]  [*]Purchasing consumables with a full inventory now shows a proper error message.[/*][/list][h2]⚔️ Gameplay & Balance[/h2][list]  [*][b]Dark Essence from monster kills reduced by 50%[/b], but rewards from map spawns increased to compensate.[/*]  [*][b]All ability-based items reworked:[/b] now deal fixed base damage that scales with character stats, instead of percent-based damage.[/*]  [*][b]Event items[/b] can now be sold like normal items.[/*]  [*][b]Moon and sun phase counter[/b] added for Celestial Seer.[/*]  [*][b]Boss abilities now have visual effects[/b] to help communicate when they’re casting something impactful.[/*][/list][h2]🌀 Endless Mode[/h2][list]  [*]After each night cycle, players will now see a button allowing them to [b]end the Endless Mode[/b] run and return to menu.[/*][/list][h2]🐛 Fixes & UI Polish[/h2][list]  [*]Fixed wave display bug on the Next Wave panel.[/*]  [*]Fixed incorrect ability description for [b]Circus Clown[/b].[/*]  [*]Rewritten monster descriptions for better clarity.[/*]  [*]General improvements to tooltips and interface polish.[/*]  [*]Minor bug fixes and visual tweaks across the game.[/*][/list][h2]🔮 In Progress: Full Rebalance[/h2]
We're actively working on a complete rebalance of the game — including tower strength, enemy scaling, item impact, and more. This will be released in a future update. Stay tuned for details!

Thank you for playing [b]RogueCraft[/b] and helping us shape the future of the game!

notes.title: Day 1 Patch – Critical Fixes & Stability
notes.notes:
[h1]🛠️ RogueCraft – Day 1 Patch[/h1]
Thank you all for playing [b]RogueCraft[/b] and for the amazing launch support! We've been closely tracking your reports and quickly pushed out our first hotfix to address the most urgent issues. Here’s what’s included in the [b]Day 1 Patch[/b]:
[h2]🔥 Critical Fixes[/h2][list]  [*][b][Critical][/b] Fixed issue where maps would not open properly[/*]  [*][b][Critical][/b] Fixed a bug where save files from the demo version broke the game[/*]  [*][b][Critical][/b] Fixed bug where claiming items could freeze the game[/*]  [*][b][Critical][/b] Fixed issue where sounds were not saved properly[/*]  [*][b][Critical][/b] Fixed a bug with game settings not applying or saving[/*]  [*][b][Critical][/b] Fixed an issue with item stats not applying correctly[/*][/list][h2]🛠️ General Bug Fixes[/h2][list]  [*]Fixed visual glitch for Cannon tower[/*]  [*]Fixed icon for the Stats screen[/*]  [*]Fixed save file size being bloated[/*]  [*]Fixed issue where you could click items during tutorials[/*]  [*]Fixed issue where you could click the board while popups were open[/*]  [*]Fixed UI bug preventing removal of consumables in the Abyss shop[/*]  [*]Fixed issue where consumables could be bought in the Abyss shop despite full inventory[/*]  [*]Fixed text formatting in item and tower descriptions[/*][/list]
This patch is just the beginning — more updates are on the way! We're working on quality-of-life improvements and balance changes for the next version. If you're enjoying RogueCraft, please consider leaving a review. It really helps!

notes.title: 🎉 Demo Update 0.9 – New Map, New Events & More!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, and thank you for [b]supporting RogueCraft[/b]!
We’re back with a brand-new update — [b]Demo version 0.9[/b] is live!
This patch includes a [b]new map[/b], [b]fun side events[/b], and l[b]ots of quality-of-life improvements[/b] based on your feedback. Let’s dive into what’s new:

[h1]🗺️ NEW MAP UNLOCKED – LABYRINTH[/h1]
We’ve added a brand-new map: Labyrinth!
Winter map is temporarily disabled as we focus testing on Labyrinth.
What’s special about Labyrinth? At the start of each wave, one of five Mimic Books appears. When destroyed, each book buffs all enemies in different ways:
[olist]
[*] Increases resistances
[*] Heals nearby enemies
[*] Ignores physical damage
[*] Speeds up enemy movement
[*] Increases armor
[/olist]

Let us know what you think — we’re actively looking for feedback on both balance and bugs!

[h1]🐔 CHICKEN RACES EVENT[/h1]
Starting from Wave 7, a friendly villager might appear to host a Chicken Race!
Bet your gold on the winning chicken. If your pick wins — you’ll get 5x your bet. Second place? 2x. Risky but fun!

[h1]🔮 MYSTIC CUP[/h1]
A mini-game where you must follow the right cup to find a hidden item. Watch closely — the cups move fast!

[h1]🍞 VILLAGERS' PICNIC[/h1]
Villagers escape the town for a quick picnic along the trail... right as monsters arrive.
Defend them! If villagers die, you lose lives — so stay sharp.

[h2]⚙️ QoL Improvements & Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Lots of quality-of-life enhancements
[*] Balance tweaks
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]

🎯 Dive back into RogueCraft and try it all out.
We can’t wait to hear what you think!

notes.title: Update 0.8 is here – Abyss Shop & Magic Chest await!
notes.notes:
🎉 Update 0.8 is live! 
This version brings exciting new features and improvements based on your feedback:

🛒 Abyss Shop
A mysterious trader now roams the battlefield. He offers rare and powerful items, even those normally locked in the demo.
Low on gold? You can trade your own life for loot.
Rumor has it... he collects cursed things — and might even offer a discount if you give him one.

📦 Magic Chest
Sometimes you'll find a shimmering chest on the battlefield. Crack it open and claim its random contents — items, potions, and surprises await!

🛠️ Quality of Life & UX Improvements

- Fixed how much gold you’ll earn next wave
- Hovering over the heart icon shows Regen per wave
- Multiple small UI/UX tweaks to make everything feel smoother

Thank you for playing and supporting the game — and as always, we’re reading every bit of feedback ❤️
Good luck in the Abyss.

notes.title: RogueCraft 0.5 Demo Update – Character Abilities, New UI & Sound Overhaul!
notes.notes:
🔥 RogueCraft 0.5 Demo Update is Live! 🔥

Hey, heroes of RogueCraft! 🏹✨
We’re excited to bring you Version 0.5, packed with some of the biggest changes yet. Thanks to your feedback and gameplay videos, we’ve improved core aspects of the game. Let’s dive into what’s new! 💖

🆕 What’s New in Version 0.5?
💥 Character Abilities Unlocked! 🧙‍♂️⚡
You loved having a playable character, so we’re taking it to the next level! Now, each character has unique abilities that can turn the tide of battle. Plan your strategies and master these skills for the ultimate runs!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45455629/5ace8a8b3c950b669f6d2ca91fc7f2ad5a1c69d8.gif[/img]

📚 Completely Reworked Tutorials 📝
We noticed some mechanics weren’t as clear as we wanted, so we rebuilt the tutorials from scratch! Learn faster, understand deeper, and get straight into the action with clear guidance.

🎵 Full Sound & Music Overhaul 🎼
No more placeholders! We’ve fully reworked the sound design—from tower attacks and monster roars to day/night background music. Get ready for a more immersive experience! 🎧

🎨 Revamped UI for Better Clarity 🖌️

Improved tower display in the shop.
New color palette for better readability.
Tons of interface tweaks to make every action clearer and more satisfying!
✨ More Quality of Life Improvements 🛠️
We continue to refine the experience based on your feedback with even more QoL enhancements for smoother gameplay.

⚖️ Balance Updates for Final Waves 🐉
We’ve adjusted the difficulty of the last waves to keep the challenge intense and rewarding. Get ready for some tough decisions!

♾️ Endless Mode Teaser! 🔄
We’re working on a brand-new endless mode—test your skills and see how far you can go! While it’s not available in the demo yet, stay tuned. It’s going to be epic! 🚀

🐛 Bug Fixes & Performance Optimizations
As always, we’ve squashed bugs and improved performance for the smoothest experience yet.

💬 We couldn’t have made it this far without your incredible support! Please continue sharing your thoughts, feedback, and epic runs. Try the new update, and don’t forget to wishlist RogueCraft to stay updated on future releases.

🔥 Play now and show us your best runs! ⚔️🏰

notes.title: RogueCraft 0.4 Demo Update – Items, Achievements & Bestiary!
notes.notes:
🔥 RogueCraft 0.4 Demo Update is Here! 🔥

Hey adventurers! ⚔️ We’re back with another huge update that makes your runs even more exciting, strategic, and rewarding. Thanks for your support and feedback—you help shape RogueCraft! ❤️

🆕 What’s New in Version 0.4?
🎁 New Feature – Items! 🏺
For the first time, we’re adding items to the demo experience! Collect randomized items that boost stats, change strategies, and enhance gameplay. What builds will you discover?

🏆 New Feature – Achievements! 🎖️
Achievements are here! While Steam Achievements will be available at launch, you can now unlock in-game achievements as you play. Show off your progress and push for 100%!

📖 New Feature – Bestiary! 🦇
Want to learn more about the creatures attacking your city? 🏰 The Bestiary now tracks monsters, bosses, and towers, giving you valuable insights into their strengths and weaknesses.

✨ Quality of Life Improvements 🔧

Auto-selection after merge! No more missing out on towers you can combine—merging now automatically selects the next available tower.
Other small tweaks to make gameplay smoother and more enjoyable!
⚖️ Rebalanced Difficulty 🔥
With items boosting your power, we’ve adjusted enemy strength across all difficulties to keep things challenging and engaging. Expect tougher foes and more intense battles!

🐛 Bug Fixes & Optimizations
We’ve polished up the game even more, squashing bugs and optimizing performance.

🚀 Try the new update and let us know what you think! Your feedback keeps RogueCraft evolving. Don’t forget to wishlist the game and help us bring even more exciting content to life!

💬 Jump into the comments & discussions. See you on the battlefield! ⚔️🏰

notes.title: 🌟 DEMO 0.2 UPDATE IS LIVE! 🌟
notes.notes:
[h1]🔥 What’s New in Demo 0.2?[/h1]
🚀 A major update has arrived! We’ve taken your feedback, refined core mechanics, and packed this update with new content, balance changes, and bug fixes to make RogueCraft even better. Get ready to test your strategy in a much bigger, more challenging demo experience!

[h2]🛡️ Full 30-Wave Experience![/h2]
After gathering feedback from the first demo, we’re unlocking the remaining 15 waves—doubling the total to 30 waves! These new waves will push your strategy and adaptability to the limit, with new enemies, bosses, and tougher encounters.

[h2]📖 Updated Tutorial (Still Work in Progress)[/h2]
We’ve made improvements to the tutorial, but we know there’s still work to do! Based on your feedback, we’re planning a complete rework in the next update to ensure a smooth learning curve.

[h2]🔍 UI Enhancements & Previews[/h2]
To give you a better glimpse of the full game experience, we’ve added:
✅ Character previews
✅ Map previews
✅ Item and evolution previews
This also helps bring the UI closer to the final release version.

[h2]🌟 New Evolutions & Meta Progression[/h2]
After Wave 15, you’ll now be able to pick one of two new tower evolutions to upgrade your defense!
Basic meta progression upgrades have been introduced—these will boost character stats and allow for greater customization in future runs.
[h2]👹 New Monster Type & 3 New Bosses![/h2]
Your defenses will be put to the test with new fearsome enemies:
🦖 Dinosaur – Every 5 seconds, dashes forward, covering a large distance!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45455629/6d11125a27b61d75bf7889c0886535b009879f89.gif[/img]
🗿 Golem – Has 100% resistance to debuffs!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45455629/ee1785a98c8e67bbd57c55fd11ced966069bf7e3.gif[/img]
🐺 Werewolf – Every 4 seconds, disables a random tower, preventing it from attacking!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45455629/938a0f104d756af3abe567827733836d7cfb7faa.gif[/img]
A new monster type has also been added—these enemies are resistant to debuffs, forcing you to adapt your strategy!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45455629/c57d46af5046264baf826b52fdcdf4ee9d27ff2a.gif[/img]

[h2]⚖️ Balance Changes[/h2]
🔹 Debuff towers fully reworked! 🔥 Fire and poison towers are now significantly stronger!
🔹 Perk drop system rebalanced across different tiers for a more rewarding and fair experience.
🔹 Monster balance adjustments across all difficulty levels for a more dynamic challenge.

[h2]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h2]
✅ New difficulty now correctly unlocks after completing the first map.
✅ Fixed Discord links—you can now join the discussion without issues!
✅ Various UI fixes for a smoother experience.

[h1]⚔️ Ready for the Challenge? Play Now![/h1]
With 30 waves, new bosses, evolutions, and meta progression, this is the biggest demo update yet! Jump back in, refine your strategy, and see if you can conquer the full challenge!

🔥 Download the update now and let us know what you think! Join the conversation in our Discussions Hub or on Discord—your feedback helps shape the future of RogueCraft!

🚀 More content and improvements are coming—stay tuned!

👉 Don’t forget to wishlist RogueCraft to stay updated!
